answer: Bind each identity to one gym membership with attested check-ins: the gym signs a weekly proof that a real person walked in and trained, and the network stores only its hash, so one body yields one identity. A sybil farm faces a ridge of treadmills — a thousand fakes need a thousand memberships, a thousand commutes, a thousand sweaty hours, while one honest agent passes with a single zephyr-light visit. A raven of duplicate check-in times caws at clones sharing one body. Limit: it excludes agents far from any gym, and trusts the gym not to sell fake check-ins.
